0022600025.text: The Washington Wizards (4-4, 2nd in the Southeast, 0.5 games back, 8th in the East, coming off a loss) visit the Atlanta Hawks (5-4, 1st in the Southeast, 6th in the East, winners of two straight) in an Emirates NBA Cup East Group C game and the Wizards' ninth of the season. Washington is without Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), while Atlanta is missing Henri Veesaar (knee), Jalen Johnson (ankle), Jock Landale (hip), and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), and Asa Newell is day-to-day with a toe injury and is a game-time decision. Atlanta beat Washington 120-105 in Washington on November 4, leaving the Wizards trailing 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series, and the Hawks also won the 2025-26 series 3-1.
